**China: how applications changed.** The extract records 819,175 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 61,680 in 2024, compared with 30,858 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 19% lower than in 2019 (38,325). Applications in 2025 were 50% lower than in 2024 (61,680). In 2025, the leading destinations were Australia (5,969; 19%), United States (5,024; 16%), Canada (4,717; 15%). Australia received 19% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 19% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 33%, across 22,231 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 26% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 9.5 percentage points lower than in 2024 (42%).
